text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-President Hrawi calls upon the deputies to keep their promises and support holding the local elections.
-Prime Minister Hariri, said after meeting Prime Minister Chretien in Ottawa, that Canada wants implementation of U.N. resolution 425 calling for a Israeli withdrawal from south Lebanon.
-Israeli shelling in eastern sector of south Lebanon.
-Teachers at state-run Lebanese University decide to go on a one-day strike instead of three days on Tuesday to protest government academic appointments.
-Eygpt's Foreign Minister Mousa said there will be no peace in the region without Syria and Lebanon.
-The government interferes illegally in the elections of the General Labour Confederation to be held on April 24.
-Fate of 60 Lebanese imigrants in Zaire unknown after they held by rebels.
